evidence.label: 明确提出新的评测资料或框架
evidence.excerpt: We introduce the Control Map, an evaluation framework that records the committed updates preceding each scored answer and separately evaluates behavioral changes, immediate learning (acquisition), later recall (retention), preservation of unrelated behavior (locality), and performance in new settings.

evidence.label: 描述评分指标或评测协议
evidence.excerpt: First, update scheduling matters: at a 760M-parameter checkpoint, 24 schedules with the same update count yield 19.7%--34.2% accuracy.
